decisions.reason: Selecting Transak changes the fiat payment provider but does not change the existing email-based dashboard access, reward areas, or intended fiat-user audience.
The provider choice affects the fiat payment path, not the existence or unlimited supply behavior of the primary NFT mint.
The Transak selection does not change Brevo as the transactional email provider or alter email delivery behavior.
Choosing Transak for fiat payments does not change SIWE authentication for crypto mint and transfer flows.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision does not alter secondary-sale royalty funding or ticket-generation rules.
The source selects a fiat payment provider but does not modify email or magic-link authentication for dashboard access.
The payment-provider switch does not change which referral, ticket, or prize information the dashboard must display.
Selecting Transak does not change the unauthenticated access mode or exposed data of public APIs.
The occurrence of the word mint is incidental; the fiat provider decision does not change badge triggers or enabled badges.
The Transak decision has no effect on the approved badge catalog or its presentation.
Changing the fiat payment provider does not modify the $5 referral commission amount or its automatic delivery mode.
The fiat on-ramp provider selection does not change the target Base network or deployment behavior.
